What is the difference between local, global and nonlocal variables?

Supplied answer
A local variable is created inside a function and exists only there. A global variable is defined at module
level and is readable everywhere; to assign to it inside a function you need the global keyword. nonlocal
is used in a nested function to modify a variable of the enclosing function, not the module.
